title: The Golden Treasure

full_text:
In the town of Odense, the drummer's wife gave birth to a boy with golden hair. An old fortune-teller prophesied: "He carries a golden treasure in his breast!" The father thought of gold ducats; the mother thought of happiness.

As the boy Peter grew, he found no joy in war drums, but poured his soul into the violin. His music wept with human sorrow and soared with celestial joy.

When war ended, he played before emperors in grand capitals, moving thousands to tears and reconciliation. The father realized that the true golden treasure was the divine melody that elevates the human spirit above earthly strife.
moral: The gift of music and genius in the soul is the true golden treasure of life.
